rows.ja: 供給元(製造・後工程・ケーブル)

relations.text: CredoはIC製造をすべてTSMCに委託し、2026年度はTSMCだけをウエハー製造に使った(2026年度、10-K)
relations.text_en: Credo outsources all IC manufacturing to TSMC, its exclusive wafer foundry in fiscal 2026 (FY2026 10-K)

source.label: Credo 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: In fiscal year 2026, we exclusively used Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (TSMC) for semiconductor wafer production.

relations.text: AmkorがCredoのIC製品のパッケージングを担当(2026年度、10-K)

source.label: Credo 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: including Amkor Technology Inc. (Amkor) and Advanced Semiconductor Engineering, Inc. (ASE) for packaging our IC products

relations.text: ASEがCredoのIC製品のパッケージングを担当(2026年度、10-K)

source.label: Credo 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: including Amkor Technology Inc. (Amkor) and Advanced Semiconductor Engineering, Inc. (ASE) for packaging our IC products
source.note: 10-Kの記載は事業会社Advanced Semiconductor Engineering, Inc.で、上場親会社はASE Technology Holdingです。
source.note_en: The filing names the operating company Advanced Semiconductor Engineering, Inc.; the listed parent is ASE Technology Holding.

relations.text: KYECがCredoのIC製品のテストを担当(2026年度、10-K)

source.label: Credo 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: King Yuan Electronics Company (KYEC) and Sigurd Microelectronics Corp. (Sigurd) for testing our IC products

relations.text: SigurdがCredoのIC製品のテストを担当(2026年度、10-K)

source.label: Credo 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: King Yuan Electronics Company (KYEC) and Sigurd Microelectronics Corp. (Sigurd) for testing our IC products

relations.text: BizLinkが長期供給契約のもとでCredoのAEC製品を製造(2026年度、10-K)
relations.text_en: BizLink manufactures Credo’s AEC products under a long-term supply agreement (FY2026 10-K)

source.label: Credo 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: BizLink Technology, Inc. (BizLink) for manufacturing our AEC products

relations.text: 製造会社との長期供給契約は、一部のAEC製品に関するBizLinkとの契約だけ(2026年度、10-K)
relations.text_en: Credo’s only long-term supply contract with a manufacturer is its agreement with BizLink for certain AEC products (FY2026 10-K)

source.label: Credo 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: Except for our agreement with BizLink for the manufacture of certain AEC products, we do not maintain long-term supply contracts with TSMC

relations.text: Amazon系の会社にワラントを発行。Amazonによる購入(最大2.01億ドル)に連動し、ワラントの株式はすべて行使済み(2026年度、10-K)
relations.text_en: Issued a warrant to an Amazon entity tied to Amazon’s purchases from Credo (up to $201.0 million); all warrant shares have been exercised (FY2026 10-K)

source.label: Credo 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: the Company issued a warrant to Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings LLC (Holder) to purchase an aggregate of up to 4.1 million of our ordinary shares
source.note: 相手はAmazonの投資子会社で、権利確定はその子会社と関係会社の支払いに左右されます。
source.note_en: Amazon is identified via its investment-holdings subsidiary; warrant vesting depends on payments by the holder and affiliates.

relations.text: Microsoftと、信頼性の高いデュアルToR構成向けのスイッチケーブルを開発し、実装をオープンソース化(2026年度、10-K)
relations.text_en: Co-developed a switch cable and open-sourced the implementation with Microsoft for a dual-ToR network architecture (FY2026 10-K)

source.label: Credo 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: Created switch cable and open-sourced implementation with Microsoft to realize their vision for a highly reliable network-managed dual-ToR architecture

relations.text: HiWire Switch AECとそのオープンソース実装でMicrosoftと提携(2025年度、10-K)
relations.text_en: Partners with Microsoft on the HiWire Switch AEC and open-source implementation (FY2025 10-K)

source.label: Credo 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We partner with Microsoft on our HiWire Switch AEC and open-source implementation

relations.text: ZeroFlap Opticsの開発でOracleと提携(2026年度、10-K)
relations.text_en: Partnered with Oracle to develop ZeroFlap Optics (FY2026 10-K)

source.label: Credo 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: We partnered with Oracle to develop our ZeroFlap Optics

relations.text: Credoが年次報告で、主な競合の1社としてBroadcomを挙げている(2026年度、10-K)
relations.text_en: Credo’s FY2026 10-K names Broadcom as a principal competitor

source.label: Credo 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: Our principal competitors with respect to our products include Broadcom Ltd. (Broadcom)
source.note: 10-K本文のページ番号の混入を避け、確認できる部分だけを引用しています。
source.note_en: The filing text has a page-number artifact after “(Broadcom)”; the quote is shortened to the verifiable part.

relations.text: Credoが年次報告で、主な競合の1社としてMarvellを挙げている(2026年度、10-K)
relations.text_en: Credo’s FY2026 10-K names Marvell as a principal competitor

source.label: Credo 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: Our principal competitors with respect to our products include Broadcom Ltd., Marvell Technology, Inc. (Marvell) and Astera Labs, Inc. (Astera)

relations.text: Marvellが年次報告で、直接の競合の1社としてCredoを挙げている(2026年度、10-K)
relations.text_en: Marvell’s FY2026 10-K names Credo among its direct competitors

source.label: Marvell 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: Cisco Systems, Inc. (“Cisco”), Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd, Intel Corporation

relations.text: Credoが年次報告で、主な競合の1社としてAstera Labsを挙げている(2026年度、10-K)
relations.text_en: Credo’s FY2026 10-K names Astera Labs as a principal competitor

source.label: Credo 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: Our principal competitors with respect to our products include Broadcom Ltd., Marvell Technology, Inc. (Marvell) and Astera Labs, Inc. (Astera)

relations.text: Astera Labsが年次報告で、主な競合の1社としてCredoを挙げている(2025年度、10-K)
relations.text_en: Astera Labs’ FY2025 10-K names Credo as a principal competitor

source.label: Astera Labs 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our principal competitors include Broadcom, Inc., Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd., Marvell Technology, Inc.
source.note: 一部の製品・ソリューションで競合する、という記載です。
source.note_en: Competes in some but not all solutions.

relations.text: MACOMが年次報告で、重要な競合の1社としてCredoを挙げている(2025年度、10-K)
relations.text_en: MACOM’s FY2025 10-K names Credo as a significant competitor

source.label: MACOM 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: our significant competitors include, among others , ADI, Broadcom, Credo, Marvell

relations.text: Cienaが年次報告で、データセンター間接続で今後競合する追加の企業の1社としてCredoを挙げている(2025年度、10-K)
relations.text_en: Ciena’s FY2025 10-K names Credo among additional competitors it will face in data-center interconnects

source.label: Ciena 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we will begin to compete with additional competitors, including Marvell Technology Group, Credo Technology Group, and Broadcom
source.note: 今後の競合に関する記載(予定段階)です。

relations.text: MaxLinearが年次報告で、主なマーチャント半導体の競合の1社としてCredo Semiconductorを挙げている(2025年度、10-K)
relations.text_en: MaxLinear’s FY2025 10-K names Credo Semiconductor among its primary merchant semiconductor competitors

source.label: MaxLinear 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Realtek Semiconductor Corp., Skyworks Solutions, Inc., Credo Semiconductor Inc., MediaTek, Inc.
source.note: 子会社のCredo Semiconductor Inc.の名前で挙げられています。
source.note_en: Names the subsidiary Credo Semiconductor Inc.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
